attempted_claim: For uniform random 3-regular graphs on n (even) vertices with l2-normalized adjacency eigenvectors, let I0=[-1,1] be the fixed central bulk window. With probability >=1-n^{-1/2}, every eigenvector psi with eigenvalue in I0 satisfies |sum_{i=1}^n a(i)*psi(i)^2| <= (log n)^{C1} / n^{alpha} for all deterministic test vectors a with sum_i a(i)=0 and ||a||_inf<=1, with explicit stated alpha=1/4 and explicit stated integer C1, proved via a short-time eigenvector-moment-flow / Dyson Brownian motion variance comparison with Kesten-McKay resolvent input.
claim_type: quantified all-vector quantum unique ergodicity variance rate (not a sup-norm bound)
decisive_failure: ['No analytic variance/moment-flow inequality proved; exact fallback certificate (N0,beta=1/4,C0) not met — binary criterion requires proof, not numerics.', 'Numeric evidence is small-scale (n<=800, few trials, configuration-model sampling) and diagnostic only; one n=400 mean-square outlier (nY=1.33) shows sampling noise.', 'No emergent original theorem/obstruction banked; half-localized separator and gap/comparison gaps are cited priors/analysis, not new results.']
